title: Redux Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the Redux course.

entries.name: Meet a store and an action
entries.summary: A store keeps state. An action is a small message saying what happened, such as one more book being read.

entries.name: Name a slice of state
entries.summary: A slice groups one part of state with the reducers that change it.

entries.name: Carry a value in an action
entries.summary: An action payload carries the information needed for a change.

entries.name: Return a new primitive value
entries.summary: When a slice state is a number or string, its reducer returns the next value.

entries.name: Update draft object fields
entries.summary: Redux Toolkit uses Immer inside createSlice reducers.

entries.name: Add a list item
entries.summary: A list reducer can add a record with a stable id.

entries.name: Select a useful piece of state
entries.summary: A selector is a function that reads state and returns the part a caller needs.

entries.name: Combine related slices
entries.summary: A store can hold several slices under different keys.

entries.name: Provide the store to React
entries.summary: React Redux Provider makes one store available to components under it.

entries.name: Read and dispatch from React
entries.summary: useSelector reads a store value for a component.

entries.name: Handle an async task state
entries.summary: An async thunk creates pending, fulfilled and rejected actions for a promise.

entries.name: Keep state changes predictable
entries.summary: Reducers should be predictable: the same state and action should produce the same result.
